title: TN: SupportReference must be a valid issue type, never an invented slug

checks.explain: There is no figs-paronomasia issue type. Hebrew wordplay / sound play (words from the same root) uses writing-poetry. Originated in a Zec 6 run that coined the slug.

checks.name: valid_support_reference

notes: Pattern check guards the specific closed bug (figs-paronomasia). The general list-membership invariant is enforced by tn-quality-check check 17 (unknown_sref, error).

title: Bold-format GLQuote words when directly quoted in Note field

notes: Cross-file check: needs the ULT verse text. Complements tn-quality-check check 8 (bold_not_in_ult). Advisory in this runner.

title: TN: AT snippets should omit final punctuation unless it differs from ULT

checks.explain: AT must not end with a period before the closing bracket (the default ULT sentence ending is omitted); ? and ! are allowed as intentional differences, and figs-rquestion rows are exempt

notes: figs-rquestion rows are exempted by the runner (their ATs legitimately end with . or !). Runner skips this pattern on rows whose SupportReference contains figs-rquestion.
